# L2 baselines: scores

*Generated by `scripts/run_l2_baselines.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

Forward-chaining: each season is scored by models trained only on earlier seasons. The 2026-season (Dec 2025) mini is held back for one run at L5. 95% CIs resample whole lots.

**Small samples (D4):** a few dozen DROP rows per season. Read the CIs, not the point values.

## Decision level: P(DROP) on {state -> RAISE/DROP} rows

`war` = contested lots after the opening bid (the hard rows; the opening bid is always RAISE).
